violations.why: The ISR can preempt JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var1 and change the value, so the two reads can disagree.
task_compute_isr can write test_global_var2 between the two consecutive reads in main, so they can see different values.
The higher-priority compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR after its write to array[TRIGGER] and overwrite it. The RR ISR then reads the changed value.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h after the RR ISR stores it and before the RR ISR uses it.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's store and its later read in the else branch.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 after the RR ISR stores it and before the RR ISR reads it.
The compute ISR can change RT4 between the RR ISR's two reads, so the computation and the threshold check use different values.
